title: EaSyGuide : ESG Issue Identification Framework leveraging Abilities of Generative Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on an NLP classification task for Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) categories. While it includes 'Business Ethics' as one of the 35 classification labels, the research is centered on model performance and data augmentation for financial news analysis rather than benchmarking or evaluating ethics, religion, or moral reasoning.
